info.title: Formspark Universal API
info.description: Formspark lets you send submissions to hosted form endpoints without running your own backend. This app wraps Formspark's documented public form submission surface, including AJAX submissions, redirect controls, feedback-page customization, reply routing, spam-protection fields, file-link submissions, and structured payload patterns.

post.description: Creates a Formspark form submission from a JSON payload.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

formId.description: The Formspark form ID from the hosted endpoint URL, for example `your-form-id` in `https://submit-form.com/your-form-id`.

email.description: Optional email field to include in the submission body.

message.description: Optional message field to include in the submission body.

name.description: Optional display name field to include in the submission body.

email.description: Echoed email value when an email field is submitted.

message.description: Echoed message value from the submitted payload.

name.description: Echoed display name value when present.
